note: Market facilities as POPULATION shares: the share of a district's rural population (Census 2011 village population) living in a village that reports the facility, Mission Antyodaya 2019-20. Coefficients are the change from no resident to every resident living in such a village, with state fixed effects and all controls (also population-weighted). solo_village keeps the village-share estimates.
